neighbours.label: a person's age given as a number ('when they were 10', '(age 22)')
fire: The twins were tested in 1991 when they were 12.
She left Rome in 1802 when she was 19.
The boys were weighed in 2003 when they were 8.
He started work in 1955 when he was 14.
quiet: The twins were tested in 1991 when they were absent.
She left Rome in 1802 when she was ill.
The boys were weighed in 2003 when they were home.
He started work in 1955 when he was poor.

notes: ' were' before an adjective reached 0.22 in a probe, so a little activation precedes the number. Words like 'sixties' stayed at 0.01.
